research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Ma’aden is researching process innovations in mining and fertilizers. Use of sulfur as alternative carbon-free fuel in an ammonia primary reformer explores sulfur combustion integrated with sulfuric acid co-production. Polluted CO2 capturing with lime produced from phosphogypsum calcination using sulfur targets CO2 sequestration and waste conversion. Integrated process to upgrade low-grade calcareous phosphate ore with low CO2 focuses on higher P2O5 recovery, decarbonization and reduced phosphogypsum, covering fuel substitution, emissions capture and ore beneficiation.

overview_description.description: Ma’aden operates as a mining and metals company. Ma’aden plays an important role in Saudi Vision 2030, the Kingdom’s strategy to diversify its economy. Our mission is to lead the development of Saudi mining into the ‘third pillar’ of industrialization in the country, beyond oil and petrochemicals.
